scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @ai-archaeologist/api && npm run build --workspace @ai-archaeologist/worker && npm run build --workspace @ai-archaeologist/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @ai-archaeologist/config && npm run build --workspace @ai-archaeologist/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @ai-archaeologist/database && npm run build --workspace @ai-archaeologist/ui
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:apps
scripts.typecheck:apps: npm run typecheck --workspace @ai-archaeologist/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @ai-archaeologist/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @ai-archaeologist/web
